a, b, n = map(int, input().split())

eps = 1000000000
best_x = 0
best_y = 0
best_bi = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    tx = (i * a) // b
    for j in range(-5, 6):
        t = tx + j
        tbi = b * i
        if abs(b * t - a * i) * best_bi < eps * tbi:
            eps = abs(b * t - a * i)
            best_x = t
            best_y = i
            best_bi = tbi

print(f"{best_x}/{best_y}")
